summary: thiscall helper that re-initializes a collision-node property pair: it first calls CollisionNodePropertySetter(byte_7CA594, *this, 0) to retire the old property value, then stores the new pair (this[1] = a3, this[0] = a2), and finally calls CollisionNodePropertySetter(byte_7CA594, a2, a3) to apply the new values, returning that call's result.

local_names.a2: new value written to this+0 and passed as the second property-setter argument
local_names.a3: new value written to this+4 and passed as the third property-setter argument

operations.description: Call CollisionNodePropertySetter(byte_7CA594, *this, 0) with the old property value read from this+0 and constant 0.
Write the new associated value a3 into this[1] (offset +4).
Write the new property value a2 into this[0] (offset +0).
Call CollisionNodePropertySetter(byte_7CA594, a2, a3) to apply the new property pair.
Return the result of the final CollisionNodePropertySetter call.
